articles.summary: THE WOODLANDS, Texas, July 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TWFG, Inc. (NASDAQ: TWFG), a leading independent insurance distribution platform, announced today that it will release its financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, after the market closes on Wednesday, August 5, 2026.
articles.title: TWFG, Inc. To Announce Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on Wednesday, August 5, 2026
